news_issues.title: Ինչպես Իշխան Զաքարյանի ընտանիքը դարձավ Ծաղկաձորի սպորտային համալիրի սեփականատեր (Hetq investigation)
news_issues.summary: The Olympic complex was leased in 2006 to New Horizon Group Inc. (Albert Boyajyan, a friend of then sports-committee head Ishkhan Zakaryan) and partly sold to it in 2010. The prosecutor's office later said that sale was about 1.3bn AMD below market value and that no rent was ever paid. The founder set up «Ծաղկաձորի սպորտային համալիր» ՍՊԸ in 2018; it bought the rest of the complex in 2022 for 732m AMD and leases 37 ha until 2056. Vardan Zakaryan (son of ex-MP Ishkhan Zakaryan) became its owner in 2024. A 2019 criminal proceeding over abuses in the alienation was reopened in 2026 and is at the pre-trial stage. In June 2026 the Zakaryan family's illicit-assets case ended in a settlement (304m AMD to the state).

news_issues.title: Կառավարությունը 7 մլն դոլարով վաճառեց Ծաղկաձորի սպորտային համալիրը
news_issues.summary: Government decision: the property of «Ծաղկաձորի գլխավոր մարզահամալիր» ՓԲԸ (valued at 3.06bn AMD) to be sold to «Ծաղկաձորի սպորտային համալիր» ՍՊԸ. The buyer must invest 400m AMD within 2 years (20% penalty on any shortfall) and must keep the complex's public sports purpose. Building housing on the grounds may conflict with that condition.

notes: The queue name is the company, not a brand. The project is 'Baza Residence' (8 floors, start 11.2024, completion II 2027) on the Tsaghkadzor Olympic sports complex grounds (district 81, building 3); ACBA's developer list shows the heading 'ԾԱՂԿԱՁՈՐ ՍՊՈՐՏԱՅԻՆ ՀԱՄԱԼԻՐ'; karucapatoxic links the project to sportcenterhotel.com, whose footer reads '© Tsaghkadzor Sport Complex Ltd'.
